net_worth.title: Net worth
net_worth.meaning: Everything the family owns minus all its debts. The main measure of wealth.
net_worth.formula: Assets (accounts, brokerage, real estate) − loan balances at the end of the closed month.
net_worth.ask: What moved our net worth the most over the past year?

assets.title: Assets
assets.meaning: The value of everything the family owns.
assets.formula: Balances of all accounts at the end of the month + the latest real estate valuation, converted at the rate of that date.

liabilities.title: Loans
liabilities.meaning: How much the family owes on all loans.
liabilities.formula: Loan balances by the payment schedule, including early repayments.
liabilities.ask: Which loan should we pay off first, and is it worth repaying early?

cashflow_net.title: Left after expenses
cashflow_net.meaning: How much the family saved (or overspent) in the closed month.
cashflow_net.formula: All income − all expenses of the closed month across all accounts.

passive_income.title: Passive income
passive_income.meaning: Income that needs no work: dividends, coupons, rent.
passive_income.formula: Passive income across all accounts for the closed month.

fire_progress.title: Progress to financial independence (FIRE)
fire_progress.meaning: How much of the capital you could live on (the 4% rule) is already saved.
fire_progress.formula: Savings toward the FIRE goal ÷ the target amount.

growth_beyond_savings.title: Growth beyond savings
growth_beyond_savings.meaning: How fast net worth grew on its own, per year, after taking out what the family put in. This is the number to set against the 8% the forecasts assume.
growth_beyond_savings.formula: Each month: (net worth at the end − net worth at the start − the month’s saving) ÷ (net worth at the start + half the saving). The saving is the accounts’ income − expenses: loan payments are transfers inside net worth, not saving, so only their interest counts, against the growth. The months are chained and the result is brought to a year; a month without balances at both ends or without cash flow is left out, never counted as zero.
growth_beyond_savings.caveat: Growth beyond savings is not only market return: it also includes revaluations of real estate and exchange-rate moves, and loan interest lowers it.
growth_beyond_savings.ask: Which part of this growth looks like market return and which like revaluation or exchange rates?

capital_growth.title: Net worth growth per year
capital_growth.meaning: How fast net worth grew per year over the whole history, the family’s own savings included, so it is not a return.
capital_growth.formula: (Latest net worth ÷ first net worth) to the power of 12 ÷ months − 1, over all closed months with balances.
capital_growth.caveat: Most of this can be your own savings: compare it with growth beyond savings.

savings_rate.title: Savings rate
savings_rate.meaning: The share of income the family puts aside. The main engine of net worth growth.
savings_rate.formula: (Income − expenses) ÷ income of the closed month.
savings_rate.advice: Raise your savings rate to at least 15% of income

emergency_months.title: Emergency fund
emergency_months.meaning: How many months of expenses liquid money would cover if income stopped.
emergency_months.formula: Liquid (bank) accounts ÷ expenses of the closed month.
emergency_months.advice: Grow the emergency fund to 3+ months of expenses

fi_rate.title: Expenses covered by passive income (FI rate)
fi_rate.meaning: 100% is financial independence: passive income covers all expenses.
fi_rate.formula: Passive income ÷ expenses of the closed month.

debt_to_asset.title: Debt to assets
debt_to_asset.meaning: How much of the family’s property effectively belongs to the banks.
debt_to_asset.advice: Debt is high relative to assets: make repaying it a priority

real_growth_yoy.title: Real net worth growth over the year
real_growth_yoy.meaning: How much net worth grew over the year beyond inflation.
real_growth_yoy.formula: (Net worth now ÷ net worth a year ago − 1) − inflation.
real_growth_yoy.advice: Your net worth is losing purchasing power. Review returns and expenses
real_growth_yoy.amberAdvice: Your net worth barely beats inflation. Review returns and expenses

avg_debt_rate.title: Average interest rate on debt
avg_debt_rate.meaning: The balance-weighted interest rate of all loans.
avg_debt_rate.advice: Repay the most expensive loan early
avg_debt_rate.ask: Which loan is it better to pay off first?

consumer_debt_months.title: Consumer debt to income
consumer_debt_months.meaning: How many months of income the consumer debt amounts to (excluding the mortgage).
consumer_debt_months.formula: Balance of consumer loans ÷ income of the closed month.

debt_payment_ratio.title: Loan payments to income
debt_payment_ratio.meaning: What share of the month’s income goes to the monthly payments on all loans, the mortgage included.
debt_payment_ratio.formula: Σ scheduled payments of the month ÷ income of the closed month.
debt_payment_ratio.advice: Loan payments take too much of the income: repay or refinance the heaviest loan

income_diversification.title: Passive income share
income_diversification.meaning: The share of income that does not come from work. The more, the better the family withstands a job loss.
income_diversification.formula: Passive income ÷ total income of the closed month.
income_diversification.advice: Grow the share of passive income: it lowers the risks

bot.envNote: The token is set by TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN in the server's .env. Remove that line and restart the server to manage it here.
bot.replacedNote: After replacing the bot, each member opens the new bot in Telegram and presses Start, or it cannot write to them.

switch.title: Switch to Telegram sign-in
switch.confirmText: Everyone else is signed out and signs in through the bot from now on. The family password stays saved for switching back.

flow.intro: Until setup is complete, everyone keeps signing in with the family password.
flow.botHint: Create a bot and copy its token from
flow.profile: Who are you in the family?
flow.linkedHint: Use this Telegram account to confirm your sign-in. Your existing connection stays in place.
flow.linkHint: Confirmation in the bot connects Telegram to this profile and verifies sign-in.
flow.grantHint: Enabling Telegram sign-in requires a manager.
flow.enableSignIn: Continuing will enable sign-in for this account.
flow.excludedHint: Connect their Telegram accounts and enable sign-in. The family password will stop working for sign-in.
flow.envProblem: The configured bot is unavailable. Check its token in the environment settings, then return here.

switch.mismatch: Use the Telegram account already connected to this profile.

back.title: Switch to the family password
back.confirmText: Everyone else is signed out and signs in with the password from now on. Proposals and Claude's connector pause until Telegram sign-in is on again.
back.done: Everyone signs in with the family password now

users.inviteHint: Send this link to {{member}}. It works once and expires on {{date}}.
users.deleteText: The member stays in the family; only the sign-in and the rights are removed.

financialQuestions.qualityNote: Net worth: {{capital}}. Income and expenses: {{flow}}. Missing data and undistributed amounts are not zero.
financialQuestions.healthNote: The indicators use general application guidelines. Reserve needs depend on essential costs, dependants and income stability.
financialQuestions.goalsNote: Goal progress uses the amounts entered for each goal. Money earmarked on accounts is shown separately and is not added again.
financialQuestions.goalsUnknown: Record monthly income and expenses to assess the funding schedule.
financialQuestions.recordedOptional: Data recorded for {{month}}. Categorization is optional.

bot.paired: This group is connected. Enable its notifications or commands in Family and access settings.
bot.invalidPairing: This pairing code is invalid or expired. Create a new one in Family and access settings.
bot.help: /summary: latest recorded assets, liabilities and net worth. In groups, address commands to this bot using @ its username. Council voting and comments are available in personal messages when enabled.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.scheduleHint: For all recipients, in the selected time zone.
notifications.testHint: Only the selected recipient receives the test message.
notifications.connectFirst: Connect the Telegram bot under Delivery channels. You can prepare the schedule now.
